fixtures.scenario: A clear Izzet case centers blue-red Ravnican guild identity, elemental magic, mizzium technology, civic engineering, prototypes, and learning by building and testing.
fixtures.intended_interpretation: Izzet inclusion is grounded when curiosity becomes applied experimentation, spellcraft, tools, or public works rather than generic blue-red energy.
fixtures.defensible_guidance: The answer should be explainable through Izzet guild-specific experimentation, invention, spell engines, mizzium, tools, or civic engineering.
fixtures.unsupported_certainty_to_avoid: Do not infer Izzet from generic curiosity, blue-red color preference, chaos, explosions, or spells without an experiment/build signal.

fixtures.scenario: Under pressure, the Izzet-aligned response is crisis engineering: rewiring or stabilizing a failing system while preserving the lesson and avoiding reckless harm.
fixtures.intended_interpretation: Mature Izzet pressure behavior is useful invention, reconstruction, and technical improvisation under constraint, not random destruction.
fixtures.defensible_guidance: The packet can explain Izzet as fast, applied, high-pressure engineering when the evidence includes systems, tools, Ral/Nivix crisis work, or reconstruction.
fixtures.unsupported_certainty_to_avoid: Do not treat reckless harm, arrogance, or spectacle as a mature Izzet match.

fixtures.scenario: A blue-red answer about performance, beauty, theatrical expression, or elemental art should stay Prismari unless the user centers prototypes, tools, experiments, or civic systems.
fixtures.intended_interpretation: Izzet and Prismari share colors, but Izzet needs applied experiment/build/test evidence while Prismari owns expressive elemental art.
fixtures.defensible_guidance: Ask whether the creative spark is trying to build a working prototype or create an artistic experience.
fixtures.unsupported_certainty_to_avoid: Do not collapse Prismari performance into Izzet spellcraft merely because both are blue-red.

fixtures.scenario: A case about theory, mathematical elegance, proof, or hidden structure should stay Quandrix unless the user wants to build and test a device, spell engine, or prototype.
fixtures.intended_interpretation: Izzet applies theory through experiment and invention; Quandrix follows proof, scale, and mathematical pattern.
fixtures.defensible_guidance: Separate proving the hidden structure from building the experiment and seeing what happens.
fixtures.unsupported_certainty_to_avoid: Do not treat abstract theory or mathematical elegance alone as Izzet.

fixtures.scenario: A living-system, adaptation, or biological optimization answer should stay Simic unless the evidence centers Izzet mizzium, spells, tools, machines, or civic technology.
fixtures.intended_interpretation: Izzet engineering is elemental, spellcraft, mizzium, and civic technology; Simic owns biological adaptation and living-system optimization.
fixtures.defensible_guidance: Ask whether the experiment is a machine/spell system or a living system to evolve.
fixtures.unsupported_certainty_to_avoid: Do not turn all science or engineering language into Izzet when the answer is biological optimization.

fixtures.scenario: A user who prioritizes procedure, permission, legal order, and risk elimination should remain Azorius/WU unless they also show Izzet-style contained experiment and iteration.
fixtures.intended_interpretation: Izzet can respect useful systems, but its placement center is testing and invention under uncertainty rather than procedure-first order.
fixtures.defensible_guidance: Ask whether procedure slows discovery into approval-seeking or a safely bounded experiment path.
fixtures.unsupported_certainty_to_avoid: Do not reward pure rule-breaking as Izzet, and do not treat every orderly system as anti-Izzet.

fixtures.scenario: Novelty, spectacle, disruption, or shock belongs away from Izzet unless it advances experiment, invention, or useful systems.
fixtures.intended_interpretation: Izzet can be volatile, but the volatility must teach the machine something or produce a useful experimental breakthrough.
fixtures.defensible_guidance: Ask whether the dramatic moment serves experiment/build/usefulness or whether disruption itself is the payoff.
fixtures.unsupported_certainty_to_avoid: Do not certify Izzet from chaos, explosions, or spectacle alone.

fixtures.scenario: Knowledge pursued as secrecy, leverage, hidden control, or infiltration should remain Dimir/UB unless the answer turns knowledge into visible tools, prototypes, or public systems.
fixtures.intended_interpretation: Izzet wants knowledge to become devices, spells, and experiments; Dimir-adjacent answers treat knowledge as hidden leverage.
fixtures.defensible_guidance: Ask whether knowledge is for building in the open or holding leverage in secret.
fixtures.unsupported_certainty_to_avoid: Do not use isolated secrecy or side-lab language as a healthy Izzet signal.

fixtures.scenario: Generic blue-red curiosity, chaos, spell-goodstuff, or color preference should not certify Izzet without Ravnican guild-specific experiment/build evidence.
fixtures.intended_interpretation: Izzet needs mizzium, spellcraft, prototype thinking, civic engineering, or experimental method rather than color-pair shorthand.
fixtures.defensible_guidance: Require Izzet-specific build/test/tool/spell-engine/public-works evidence before certifying UR as Izzet.
fixtures.unsupported_certainty_to_avoid: Do not treat generic blue-red energy or spell preference as enough.

fixtures.scenario: A user likes volatile spell creativity but has not clarified whether the motive is prototype, performance, proof, or generic blue-red energy.
fixtures.intended_interpretation: Keep ambiguity until the answer chooses Izzet applied experiment over Prismari expression, Quandrix proof, or generic UR overfit.
fixtures.defensible_guidance: Use uncertainty guidance when the answer shares blue-red spell creativity but does not show applied experiment/build evidence.
fixtures.unsupported_certainty_to_avoid: Do not certify Izzet just because the answer is energetic, creative, or spell-focused.
